stem: A client is receiving IV acetaminophen and also takes an oral combination product that contains acetaminophen. What should the nurse do when assessing the maximum daily acetaminophen dose?

options.A: Count only the IV acetaminophen doses.
options.B: Count only oral acetaminophen because IV dosing has a separate limit.
options.C: Add acetaminophen from all routes and all acetaminophen-containing products before comparing the total with the recommended daily maximum.
options.D: Double the daily oral allowance when IV acetaminophen is prescribed concurrently.

rationale: Current acetaminophen injection labeling states that the maximum daily acetaminophen dose is based on all routes of administration and all acetaminophen-containing products, including combination products. The total from every source must be added before determining whether the recommended maximum has been reached. Therefore C is correct.
educational_objective: Calculate total daily acetaminophen exposure across all routes and combination products to prevent overdose.
source_organization: DailyMed / U.S. National Library of Medicine
source_locator: Dosage and Administration 2.1 General Dosing Information; 2.2 Recommended Dosage — Adults and Adolescents
source_claim_supported: Maximum daily acetaminophen exposure includes all routes and all acetaminophen-containing products; exceeding the recommended maximum may cause serious hepatic injury.
blueprint_source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
blueprint_locator: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies — dosage calculation and prevention of medication toxicity
blueprint_topic: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies — cumulative acetaminophen dosing
correction_summary: Removed the conversational cueing and preserved the exact label-supported principle that all routes and acetaminophen-containing products contribute to the daily maximum. Reduced difficulty from hard to easy.
audit_findings: DailyMed sections 2.1 and 2.2 directly support C. A, B and D contradict the all-routes/all-products rule. Independent second pass confirmed C is uniquely correct.
